messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up: Sam told me vendor X pushed rack delivery in EU to ~18 weeks (was 6-8). This will hit Dedicated onboarding for two queued customers. Need mitigation plan.
ajay (infra): Yikes. Which customers and do we already have POs placed?
sam_hw_partner: Confirmed from vendor side — PSU + specific GPU SKU backlog. They can do prioritized partial shipments for committed deals if we provide PO numbers and signed SOWs.
lisa_sales: Customers: AcmeHealth (enterprise, signed contract) and BoltMedia (pilot). Acme has reserve commit. PO for Acme: `PO-ACM-00234` — contract attached to deal.
ajay (infra): Okay. Short-term options: 1) use cloud marketplace reserved SKUs in eu-west to cover capacity (slightly higher $/token), 2) hybrid: run critical traffic on cloud instances and backlog serving on future racks, 3) offer temporary throttling to non-critical tenants. Any data residency/legal blockers?
sam_hw_partner: We can push an escalation to manufacturing and request a partial shipment (enough for 4 racks) in ~4–6 weeks if we sign off on priority. Need a formal commitment + PO number.
nate (customer-svcs): We should proactively notify Acme and offer a mitigation package (credit + temporary cloud capacity). Suggest offering 10% service credit + free migration assistance.
maria (partnerships): Agreed. I'll draft customer note. Action items: - maria: notify Acme + Bolt, offer mitigation package - ajay: validate technical feasibility for marketplace SKU fallback and cost delta - sam: escalate with vendor and confirm earliest partial ship date with PO - nate: prepare customer comms template / credits
deploy-bot: created ticket PRJ-4321 in partnerships backlog for vendor escalation.
ajay (infra): Quick config note: to route to cloud-marketplace SKU we need to update routing policy `region->fallback` and add a new model-variant tag. Small infra change, can be done in a couple of hours. I'll estimate cost delta and post here.
lisa_sales: For Acme we should also consider prioritizing their onboarding in our internal queue once hardware arrives. I'll hold their onboarding slot.
maria (partnerships): Sam — please confirm by EOD if vendor will accept PO `PO-ACM-00234` as priority and what the partial ETA looks like. If not, we'll trigger cloud fallback plan. :thumbsup:
sam_hw_partner: Will confirm by EOD. Escalation note sent to vendor rep (cc @maria).
maria (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll post the customer note draft in #partnerships later today for review.
